subject: Scheduling: staggered demo windows for Acme — AE/SE + Procurement + Security
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@acmeinc.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Jin Park <jin.park@acmeinc.com>, procurement@acmeinc.com, security@acmeinc.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Redwood demo — trying to find a repeating cadence that fits our org

Hey Karthik,

Thanks for the intro last week. We'd like to get a technical demo with your AE and SE present so our engineers, procurement, and security folks can all validate fit. Our teams are distributed (SF, London, Singapore) so we asked if you can propose a repeating window pattern that rotates between regions rather than a single fixed time. Ideally we want a monthly 60–90 minute session that alternates between an Americas-friendly, EMEA-friendly, and APAC-friendly slot.

Audience: Jin (security), Proc (procurement), backend eng leads (Alex + 2), and a product manager.

Constraints:
- Procurement needs to see an initial commercial outline/quote before we lock recurring calendar holds.
- Security wants to review SOC 2 summary ahead of the first session.
- We prefer a consistent pattern (e.g., first Tue = Americas, second Tue = EMEA, third Tue = APAC) if that's something you can support.

Can you propose 3 rotating windows with local time examples and confirm who from Redwood will present? Also note any one-off windows for an overlapping kickoff meeting if needed.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Wu
Staff Engineer, Acme Inc

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@acmeinc.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ava_chen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — trying to find a repeating cadence that fits our org

Alex —

Appreciate the context and the clear constraints. Happy to lead coordination on our side. I've looped in Marissa (AE) and Ava (SE) — Marissa will drive the commercial/recurring cadence and procurement conversation; Ava will run the technical demo.

Attached is a short agenda we typically use for a 75-minute session (MVP-demo-agenda.pdf). Below are three suggested rotating windows (all subjective examples; I'll include local equivalents):

Option A — Americas-friendly (Month A)
- 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 GMT (60–75 mins)
Option B — EMEA-friendly (Month B)
- 14:00 GMT / 15:00 CET / 10:00 ET (60–75 mins)
Option C — APAC-friendly (Month C)
- 09:00 SGT / 02:00 GMT / 21:00 ET (60–75 mins) — note this biases toward APAC local mornings and late US evenings

We can do an initial kickoff overlap that hits all regions for a one-time event: 16:00 GMT / 09:00 PT / 01:00 SGT (90 mins) — Ava would handle the technical walkthrough and I will handle the commercial intro.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll follow up with a high-level quote for procurement (Marissa) and attach the SOC2 summary for Jin/security.
- Please confirm which rotating pattern (A/B/C ordering) you'd prefer and whether procurement needs a formal PO or a signed MSA first.

Quick ask for scheduling: please share 2–3 preferred Tuesdays/Thursdays in Dec–Jan for the kickoff overlap. We'll publish recurring invites from there.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: ava_chen@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — trying to find a repeating cadence that fits our org (internal)

Karthik / Marissa —

I can run the demo and will prepare a short appendix for the SOC2 points the security team usually asks about (data retention, KMS integrations, audit logs, private deployment options). For the live demo I suggest we keep the hands-on section to 25 minutes and allocate time for procurement questions at the end.

Availability: For the rotating pattern I can do most EMEA slots and the APAC-friendly slot if it's within a 02:00–06:00 GMT window. For kickoff overlap my availability on the suggested dates is: Dec 8 (flexible), Dec 15 (AM PST), Jan 5 (blocked).

I'll draft the technical agenda and hand it to you for the invite.

—Ava
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@acmeinc.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ava_chen@redwood.ai, procurement@acmeinc.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed rotating schedule + docs/quote next steps

Alex / Jin / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Based on internal availability we propose the following recurring pattern (simple monthly rotation):

- Month 1 (Americas): 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 GMT — 75 mins
- Month 2 (EMEA): 14:00 GMT / 15:00 CET / 10:00 ET — 75 mins
- Month 3 (APAC): 09:00 SGT / 02:00 GMT / 21:00 ET — 75 mins

Kickoff overlap (one-time): Wednesday, Dec 15, 2026 — 16:00 GMT / 09:00 PT / 01:00 SGT — 90 mins (Ava + Karthik present)

Action items for Redwood (I'll own these):
1) Send a preliminary quote and outline for procurement (attached: quote-RDW-3741.pdf).
2) Share SOC2 summary for security review (attached: SOC2-Summary.pdf).
3) Publish the recurring invites once we confirm which day of month you'd prefer (we suggested Tue/Thu but can do Wed for kickoff).

Questions for you:
- Procurement: do you need a draft MSA or is a PO good to secure the recurring calendar?
- Security (Jin): can you confirm whether the SOC2 summary and a short 30-min follow-up call is enough before the first hands-on demo?

If the dates look ok I'll pencil Dec 15 for the kickoff and send a calendar hold this afternoon.

Best,
Karthik
From: procurement@acmeinc.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@acmeinc.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2026 08:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed rotating schedule + docs/quote next steps

Karthik,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the quote. Procurement preference: we need an initial commercial outline to include estimated monthly usage ranges and an outline of billing terms to share internally. A PO is preferable after we lock the recurring schedule; the signed MSA would be required for billing over $100k ARR but for pilots we can start with a PO and a shortened purchase schedule.

Also: please confirm if Redwood supports our SSO (SAML) integration for the pilot and whether any customer data will be routed through Redwood-hosted logs (we need the security team to sign off).

We'll confirm Dec 15 for the kickoff if security signs off.

Regards,
Maya R.
Head of Procurement | Acme Inc
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Jin Park <jin.park@acmeinc.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@acmeinc.com>, procurement@acmeinc.com
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed rotating schedule + docs/quote next steps

Maya / Jin / Alex —

Great, thanks Maya. To confirm next steps:
- We'll proceed to book the Dec 15 kickoff (16:00 GMT) as a tentative hold and will send the invite once you confirm.
- Marissa will follow up with an expanded commercial outline (usage bands and billing cadence).
- Ava will prepare the SOC2 appendix and is open to a 30-min pre-demo call with Jin; Jin, can you share a couple of 30-min slots next week (GMT window preferred)?
- Regarding SSO: we do support SAML SSO for Redwood Private and Hosted with customer-managed SSO; we will provide a short integration doc prior to the kickoff.

Attachments included: SOC2-Summary.pdf (for Jin) and quote-RDW-3741.pdf (procurement). If Dec 15 works for your team, we'll send the calendar invites and recurring series with the simple monthly rotation described.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

Karthik Iyer
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
